conditions.workload: Identical application files; original 100-row fixture before independent extended phase and final warm renderer IPC.
conditions.scope: Synthetic workload; not a VS Code, Monaco, extension-host or production desktop benchmark
conditions.idleCpuZero: Zero means below process CPU tick resolution during roughly two seconds of sampling.
conditions.comparisonWithPrevious: Shared CI runner timings vary; no same-run optimization ablation. IPC and larger component latency still exceed Electron.

extendedConditions.ipc: Eight rounds of 32 concurrent invokes per window, 64 total, checking every result.
extendedConditions.components: 1000 row elements per window; six rounds change 256 rows per window then wait two animation frames and capture both windows.
extendedConditions.idle: Five process-tree samples 500 ms apart after 500 ms settling.

rendererIpcConditions.timing: Inside one renderer script, after both original idle phases. Same isolated contextBridge/preload path; excludes per-invocation executeJavaScript request/completion.
rendererIpcConditions.aggregation: Median of three per-trial mean round-trip times.

changesSincePrevious: Only Monaco diagnostic error observation changed since ebc3f31; runtime and benchmark source are identical. Timing differences between these runs are not another code optimization.
